request.deadline: Period begins at the start of Epoch 613 on February 13, 2026 and ends at the close of Epoch 713 on or about July 3, 2027
deliverables: Set a fixed cap of 500,000,000 ada on total Treasury withdrawals debited during Epochs 613-713
Supersede any prior Net Change Limit for the same period
Record DRep agreement if Yes votes exceed 50% of active voting stake
Clarify that the action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal
request.what: Info action to agree a new Net Change Limit for Cardano Treasury withdrawals for Epochs 613-713

claims.claim: The proposal sets a new Net Change Limit of 500,000,000 ada for Cardano Treasury withdrawals during Epochs 613-713.
The proposed limit caps only total lovelace removed from the Treasury through enacted Treasury Withdrawals and does not count Treasury inflows.
Treasury Withdrawals already debited during the Epoch 613-713 period count toward the proposed 500,000,000 ada cumulative limit.
The proposal states that this Info action has no direct on-chain effect and does not authorize any Treasury Withdrawal.
The proposal says it supersedes any prior Net Change Limit for the same Epoch 613-713 period, including a previously agreed 350,000,000 ada limit.
The proposer claims the existing 350,000,000 ada limit has become practically constrained while its window runs into mid-2027.
The proposer claims a 500,000,000 ada limit preserves DReps' ability to consider credible Treasury Withdrawals on their merits while retaining a fixed fiscal guardrail.
The proposal states that Yes votes exceeding 50% of active voting stake are the TREASURY-01a threshold for agreeing a Net Change Limit.
The proposal claims it complies with the enacted Cardano Constitution version 2.4 and Appendix I Guardrails, and references the constitution by IPFS URI.
The proposal asserts that nothing in the Constitution limits DReps to a single Net Change Limit or prevents a newly agreed Net Change Limit from applying to the same period.

summary: The document proposes an Info action to raise and define the Cardano Treasury Net Change Limit for Epochs 613-713 at 500,000,000 ada, with detailed accounting rules but limited evidence for the fiscal need and constitutional interpretation beyond an external constitution reference.
